dossier.title: Configuration dossiers
dossier.description: The document describing how a company is configured: identity, industry model and process decisions.
dossier.name: Name
dossier.emptyDescription: No configuration dossier has been composed yet.
dossier.error: The dossiers could not be loaded.
dossier.caption: List of configuration dossiers
dossier.createHint: A dossier may exist before the company: during a negotiation the company is left empty.

identity.incomplete: Fill in activity and size band to receive a model proposal.

proposal.title: Proposed model
proposal.noFallback: No similar model is proposed: it would be a false answer.

decisions.rationaleRequired: A decision without a rationale is not a decision.
decisions.cleared: The decision was removed: the model applies.
decisions.empty: No model pinned yet: there is nothing to decide on.

submit.done: Version submitted: an approval request was opened.

build.title: Company build
build.description: The plan of what would be created, and the signature that creates it. Two distinct steps, and neither builds on its own.
build.planIsReadOnly: Asking for the plan writes nothing: it is a read, and the numbers below are a forecast.
build.planError: The plan cannot be computed for this version.
build.alreadyThereMeans: "Already there" is what tells a fresh build apart from a re-apply onto an already populated company.
build.applyOpensApproval: Applying does NOT build: it opens an approval request. The build happens when that request is approved.
build.noCountsYet: No row counts, and that is not an omission: nothing has been built yet.
build.blockedNoPermission: Write permission on dossiers is required.
build.blockedApplied: This version has already been applied.
build.blockedNotApproved: The version is in state {{status}}: only an approved version can be applied.
build.registryHint: After the build, every row created by this version is listed in the registry, with its table and rationale.
